diseases.label: Sickle cell anemia (HbSS)
diseases.notes: Narrow genotype focus for this project. Upstream ontologies often merge HbSS with broader SCD labels (e.g. MONDO:0011382); preserve local genotype scope rather than merging synonyms.

diseases.label: Sickle cell disease (broad)
diseases.notes: Umbrella clinical category including HbSS, HbSC, HbS/β-thalassemia, and other genotypes. Shares MONDO with some HbSS mappings; do not collapse local nodes.

diseases.label: Sickle cell trait
diseases.notes: Carrier state; keep separate from sickle cell disease.

diseases.label: Beta-thalassemia (genetic)
diseases.notes: Genetic category caused by reduced/absent HBB expression; subtypes by allele severity. OMIM:613985 / MONDO:0013517 may appear as related entries—preserve mappings rather than merging every synonym.

diseases.label: Beta-thalassemia major
diseases.notes: Clinical severity label; not identical to a single genotype.

diseases.label: Transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia
diseases.notes: Phenotype/clinical category used in trials; preserve separately from genetic subtype labels.

diseases.label: HbS/β-thalassemia
diseases.notes: Compound heterozygous genotype; optional later focus.

bridge_hypothesis.label: Fetal hemoglobin reactivation as a cross-disease bridge
bridge_hypothesis.mechanism: BCL11A erythroid-enhancer editing increases HbF, which can ameliorate both SCD and β-thalassemia pathophysiology via distinct clinical endpoints.
bridge_hypothesis.caveat: exa-cel edits BCL11A, not HBB. Cross-disease asset reuse (e.g., mouse models, registries) requires explicit validation.
